In 1762 he commissioned Sir William Chambers to build a mansion on his estate at Peper Harow in Surrey. He died before it was complete and his son completed it once he came of age. The house is now a Grade I listed building. He died of an abscess in the spleen on 22 August 1765 and was buried six days later at Wandsworth.
